title: A C¹ map with injective derivative at w is antilipschitz on a ball around w
statement: Let n, Q ∈ ℕ, let G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be C¹ (ℝᵐ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), and let w ∈ ℝⁿ be such that the derivative DG(w) is injective. Then there are r > 0 and c > 0 such that c|z − z′| ≤ |G(z) − G(z′)| for all z, z′ in the open ball B_r(w).
lean_statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (G : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (w : Eucl n), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G w) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball w r, ∀ z' ∈ ball w r, c * ‖z - z'‖ ≤ ‖G z - G z'‖
